info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Branch Currency Management API
info.description: The Branch Currency Management API enables businesses to modify and manage currency settings at specific banking channels. It provides functionalities to update currency configurations efficiently, ensuring accurate and timely financial processing. Typical consumers of this API include banking applications, financial institutions, and third-party integrations that require dynamic currency management capabilities. This API supports essential operations for maintaining currency records relevant to specific branches, enhancing operational flexibility.

patch.summary: Update branch currency details for a specific resource.
patch.description: This operation allows you to update the currency management settings for a specific branch identified by its resource ID. Ensure you provide the necessary data in the request body to successfully apply the changes.

requestBody.description: This endpoint allows for updating the branch currency management for a specific resource identified by RES-100045. The provided JSON payload must conform to the specified schema and include all necessary fields to ensure successful update of the currency management details.
